findings.one_line: The proposed headline is an explicit parameter-uniform finite-piece frontier, but this node leaves existence of B and equality with the finite program open; the delivered supporting results are a weaker kernel, not that object.

For the active-ceiling class, H_zeta and h_zeta are only suprema/infima over a newly defined attainable set of arbitrary measurable hazards; with the finite-switch theorem unresolved, no general computable map, explicit constrained program, or certified evaluation algorithm is supplied for the claimed sharp bounds.

The node presents the L-to-bar-L comparison as a sensitivity analysis but supplies only set nesting at two ceilings; it defines neither evaluable endpoint trajectories in the ceiling nor a critical-ceiling mathematical object at which a named conclusion changes.
